note: Formats with proven demand (owner reset, 2026-10-21). Every plan's `story` is one of these ids for its format, and its `demand` names a reference video. Research adds formats and examples from the nightly demand scan; the improver retires formats our own numbers say don't work. Views as read on the day in `seen`. Since 2026-10-23 the channel is global first (generator/reach.py): `markets` lists `global` for formats anyone in the world can relate to. `tier` (2026-10-30, owner: big-money topics brought every 1K+ Short and every subscriber): `core` formats fill at least 2 of every 3 Shorts; `low` ones rank last.
